summary: The global functions setTimeout, setInterval, clearTimeout and clearInterval. Server scripts also have setImmediate and clearImmediate, which bundled Node packages expect. A timer belongs to the resource that set it, and all are cleared when it stops. A timer handler that throws makes the resource fail.

setTimeout.summary: Runs a handler once after a delay.

setInterval.summary: Runs a handler repeatedly, every `delay` milliseconds.
setInterval.exampleLua:
local changingRain = setInterval(function() return kcds.world.World.setRain(math.random(), 1) end, 60000)
clearInterval(changingRain)

clearTimeout.example:
const reminder = setTimeout(() => kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, 'Pay your rent!'), 60000);
clearTimeout(reminder);
clearTimeout.exampleLua:
local reminder = setTimeout(function() return kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Pay your rent!") end, 60000)
clearTimeout(reminder)
clearTimeout.exampleCs:
var reminder = Timers.SetTimeout(() => Chat.SendToPlayer(player, "Pay your rent!"), 60000);
Timers.ClearTimeout(reminder);

clearInterval.example:
const tick = setInterval(() => console.info('tick'), 1000);
setTimeout(() => clearInterval(tick), 5000);
clearInterval.exampleLua:
local tick = setInterval(function() return print("tick") end, 1000)
setTimeout(function() return clearInterval(tick) end, 5000)
clearInterval.exampleCs:
var tick = Timers.SetInterval(() => Log.Info("tick"), 1000);
Timers.SetTimeout(() => Timers.ClearInterval(tick), 5000);

setImmediate.summary: Server scripts only. Runs a handler once, right after the current work and before any timer, like Node's setImmediate.
setImmediate.exampleLua: setImmediate(function() return print("the resource finished loading") end)

clearImmediate.summary: Server scripts only. Cancels a setImmediate that has not run.
clearImmediate.exampleLua:
local job = setImmediate(function() return rebuildScoreboard() end)
clearImmediate(job)
